instruction: Fix `encode_query` in `codec/url.py` so the *key* is percent-encoded the same way as the value. The current code interpolates the raw key into the query string without encoding it (and without `str()`-ing it), so keys containing spaces or reserved characters produce an invalid query string.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/url.py b/codec/url.py
--- a/codec/url.py
+++ b/codec/url.py
@@ -17,7 +17,7 @@
     """Serialize ``params`` into a percent-encoded query string."""
     parts = []
     for key, value in params.items():
-        parts.append(f"{key}={quote(str(value), safe='')}")
+        parts.append(f"{quote(str(key), safe='')}={quote(str(value), safe='')}")
     return "&".join(parts)
